combo_label: Jobs & Professions × Musical Instruments × Polar Exploration

entries.clue: Runnered load-carrier hauled by dog teams or by men in harness
Where every meridian finally meets, and the great southern races ended
Sweats a copper joint and clears the blockage that flooded your kitchen
Curved metal body with a hooked neck, honking and breathy in a jazz solo
Dog-driving Norwegian who reached 90 degrees south five weeks ahead
Checks the chart, changes the drip and works the night shift on the ward
Tacks on a new heel and stitches a split sole back together
Flat Alpine soundboard, many taut strings, laid on a table and plucked
Hanging bronze circle struck once and left to shiver for an age
Teardrop body, paired strings, and a shivering tremolo picked in bluegrass
